an3.126:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno yena Kapilavatthu tad avasari.
an3.126:1.2: Assosi kho Mahānāmo Sakko Bhagavā kira Kapilavatthum anuppatto ti.
an3.126:1.3: Atha kho Mahānāmo Sakko yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami. Upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho Mahānāmaṃ Sakkaṃ Bhagavā etad avoca:
an3.126:2.1: Gaccha Mahānāma Kapilavatthusmiṃ tathārūpaṃ āvasathaṃ jāna, yatth' ajja mayaṃ ekarattiṃ vihareyyāmā ti.
an3.126:2.2: Evaṃ bhante ti kho Mahānāmo Sakko Bhagavato paṭissutvā Kapilavatthuṃ pavisitvā kevalakappaṃ Kapilavatthuṃ anvāhiṇḍanto na addasa Kapilavatthusmiṃ tathārūpaṃ āvasathaṃ yattha Bhagavā ekarattiṃ vihareyya.
an3.126:3.1: Atha kho Mahānāmo Sakko yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami. Upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca: 2.
an3.126:3.2: N' atthi bhante Kapilavatthusmiṃ tathārūpo āvasatho yatth' ajja Bhagavā ekarattiṃ vihareyya.
an3.126:3.3: Ayaṃ bhante Bharaṇḍu<ko> Kālāmo Bhagavato purāṇasabrahmacārī.
an3.126:3.4: Tass' ajja Bhagavā assame ekarattiṃ viharatū ti.
an3.126:3.6: Evaṃ bhante ti kho Mahānāmo Sakko Bhagavato paṭissutvā yena Bharaṇḍukassa Kālāmassa assamo ten' upasaṅkami. Upasaṅkamitvā santharaṃ paññāpetvā udakaṃ ṭhapetvā pādānaṃ dhovanāya yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami. Upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
an3.126:3.7: Santhato bhante santharo udakaṃ ṭhapitaṃ pādānaṃ dhovanāya.
an3.126:3.8: Yassa dāni bhante Bhagavā kālaṃ maññatī ti. 3.
an3.126:4.1: Atha kho Bhagavā yena Bharaṇḍukassa Kālāmassa assamo ten' upasaṅkami. Upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi,
an3.126:4.3: Atha kho Mahānāmassa Sakkassa etad ahosi:
an3.126:4.6: sve dānāhaṃ Bhagavantaṃ payirupāsissāmī ti. Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
an3.126:5.1: Atha kho Mahānāmo Sakko tassā rattiyā accayena yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami. Upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Mahānāmaṃ Sakkaṃ Bhagavā etad avoca: 4.
an3.126:5.2: Tayo kho 'me Mahānāma satthāro santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an3.126:5.4: Idha Mahānāma ekacco satthā kāmānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti
an3.126:5.5: na rūpānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti na vedanānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti.
an3.126:5.6: Idha pana Mahānāma ekacco satthā kāmānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti rūpānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti
an3.126:5.8: Idha pana Mahānāma ekacco satthā kāmānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti rūpānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti vedanānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti.
an3.126:5.9: Ime kho Mahānāma tayo satthāro santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an3.126:5.10: Imesaṃ Mahānāma tiṇṇaṃ satthārānaṃ ekā niṭṭhā udāhu puthu niṭṭhā ti? 5.
an3.126:6.1: Evaṃ vutte Bharaṇḍu Kālāmo Mahānāmaṃ Sakkaṃ etad avoca:--
an3.126:6.3: Evaṃ vutte Bhagavā Mahānāmaṃ Sakkaṃ etad avoca.
an3.126:6.5: Dutiyam pi kho Bharaṇḍu Kālāmo Mahānāmaṃ Sakkaṃ etad avoca:--
an3.126:6.7: Dutiyam pi kho Bhagavā Mahānāmaṃ Sakkaṃ etad avoca:--
an3.126:6.9: Tatiyam pi kho Bharaṇḍu Kālāmo Mahānāmaṃ Sakkaṃ etad avoca:--
an3.126:6.11: Tatiyam pi kho Bhagavā Mahānāmaṃ Sakkaṃ etad avoca:-Nānā
an3.126:7.1: Atha kho Bharaṇḍukassa Kālāmassa etad ahosi:
an3.126:7.2: Mahesakkhassa vat' amhi Mahānāmassa Sakkassa sammukhā samaṇena Gotamena yāva tatiyakaṃ apasādito.
an3.126:7.4: Atha kho Bharaṇḍu Kālāmo Kapilavatthumhā pakkāmi,
an3.126:7.5: yaṃ Kapilavatthumhā pakkāmi tadā pakkanto va ahosi na puna pacchāgañchī
